hints.title: Bounded Shift Count
hints.text: Performing k operations cyclically rotates the available costs across the items.

hints.title: Prefix Minimum Cost
hints.text: Track the minimum cost seen so far for each chocolate type as k increases from 0 to n minus 1.

hints.title: Shift Cost Accumulation
hints.text: At each rotation step, sum up the optimal individual costs and add the rotation cost k times x.

hints.title: Cyclic Shift DP Code
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minCost(self, nums: list[int], x: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        cur_costs = list(nums)
        ans = sum(cur_costs)
        for k in range(1, n):
            cur_costs = [min(cur_costs[i], nums[(i - k) % n]) for i in range(n)]
            ans = min(ans, sum(cur_costs) + k * x)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Testing all n rotation shifts updates minimum costs incrementally.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining non-cyclic combinations yields exponential branches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of size n records best cost seen so far per item.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that at most n-1 operations are needed and tracks running minima.
